summary: This Form 6-K, filed by BRP Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, provides copies of the notice of annual meeting of shareholders, management proxy circular, and form of proxy for the 2026 annual meeting scheduled for May 28, 2026. The meeting covers routine matters such as receiving audited financial statements, electing 12 directors, appointing an independent auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. There are no special-situation events like acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing constitutes a routine notice for an ordinary annual shareholder meeting, not a special situation.
